headline: No scored news; the lines hold steady
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The only movement was the slow fade of earlier announcements, shifting a handful of endings by a hundredth of a point. Horizon Balance reads -4.23. Enslaved God, a boxed superintelligence owned by one player, still leads at 41.56, ahead of Conquerors at 27.27.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; changes came only from fading earlier events, at 0.01 each.
